newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-FRENCHMAN MENGIN WINS SWISS STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-FRENCHMAN MENGIN WINS SWISS STAGE.

text.p: French cyclocross champion Christophe Mengin won the final sprint to take the 16th stage of the Tour de France on Tuesday.

The Francaise des Jeux rider won the 181-km leg from Morzine in the French Alps to the Swiss city of Fribourg ahead of Belgian Franck Vandenbroucke with compatriot Richard Virenque, second overall, third.
Germany's Jan Ullrich, finishing in the same time, retained the overall leader's yellow jersey.
Defending champion Bjarne Riis had a poor day, dropping from fourth to seventh overall after trailing in six minutes 12 seconds behind Mengin.
